items.title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
items.why: It provides a practical workflow using AI coding agents to find and speed up slow bottlenecks in your Python applications.
items.summary: Fast-anything is a profiling tool that uses AI coding assistants to rewrite only the slowest 5% of your code. Instead of rewriting an entire project in a language like Rust, it targets just the performance bottlenecks.

items.title: sybil-solutions/skill-distill
items.why: It provides a practical open-source tool for translating advanced AI coding workflows to local models.
items.summary: Skill-distill is an open-source project that extracts useful skills from Claude Code or Codex sessions into reusable prompts. This lets open-weight AI models replicate complex developer tasks.

items.title: A training engine for your local model, using your idle compute
items.why: It offers a practical way to experiment with training local machine learning models without expensive hardware.
items.summary: This project is a training engine designed to fine-tune AI models on your local computer by utilizing background idle compute time.

items.title: iamajmeena/neonclipping
items.why: It is a great example of an open-source local AI project that combines multimedia processing with LLMs.
items.summary: Neonclipping is a free tool that generates captioned vertical videos from links in about two minutes. It runs entirely on your local machine using open-source audio processing and local language models.

items.title: danielwh2/sprite-stacking
items.why: This demonstrates how you can create custom skills for popular AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
items.summary: Sprite-stacking is an AI agent skill that transforms four 2D pixel art images into interactive fake-3D sprites. It works inside popular code editors like Cursor and Claude Code.

items.title: Ladybird is now in alpha
items.why: Ladybird is one of the most exciting open-source software efforts building an independent web browser from scratch.
items.summary: The Ladybird web browser has reached its official alpha release. Unlike most modern browsers based on Google's Chromium code, Ladybird is built completely from scratch as an open-source project.

items.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
items.why: As you learn about AI agents, understanding vendor incentives helps you build smarter projects and choose open tools.
items.summary: This article discusses how commercial AI agents are often designed to serve their creator company's business ecosystem rather than the end user. It argues for open standards and user-aligned AI agent architectures.

items.title: Launch HN: Versine (YC F26) – MCP to send and receive money
items.why: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an important emerging technology that allows AI agents to interact with external services.
items.summary: Versine is a Y Combinator-backed project that provides an MCP interface for AI agents to send and request money. MCP is a standard format enabling AI models to interact with real-world apps and APIs.

items.title: Asia’s stock markets dive as doubts swirl over AI boom
items.why: It gives you insight into financial market trends and corporate investments surrounding the AI industry.
items.summary: Major Asian stock markets dropped significantly due to growing investor skepticism about the financial returns on massive AI investments. The sell-off affected major tech companies in Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.

items.title: China-linked network using AI fakes to smear Taiwan election candidates, BBC Verify finds
items.why: This shows how artificial intelligence is being used in real-world geopolitical campaign manipulation.
items.summary: A BBC investigation revealed a China-linked network using AI-generated deepfakes to target Taiwanese election candidates. The effort aimed to covertly influence public opinion during political campaigns.

items.title: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine
items.why: It reports on significant global statistics regarding the human toll of the conflict in Ukraine.
items.summary: Leaked official data indicates that nearly 500,000 Russian military personnel have died during the war in Ukraine. The figures show how the conflict has drastically affected Russia's mortality statistics.

items.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
items.why: It keeps you updated on major political and military events in the ongoing Middle East conflict.
items.summary: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed Hamas internal security chief Naeem Abu Nahel. The strike was part of ongoing military operations in the region.
